pages.text: MADAGASPICES Group  Lot 12 Bis Parcelle 12/14  Tanamakoa  501 Toamasina   - Madagascar  ——————————————————————————————————  TECHNICAL SHEET :MADAGASCAR VANILLA BEAN GOURMET  EXTRA CM 18/22  ——————————————————————————————————  Botanic name : VANIGLIA PLANIFOLIA  Productor: MADAGASCAR VANILLE EXPORT, Toamasina   -   MADAGASCAR  Descri:ption : VANILLA BEANS  Use : GELATERIA AND PASTRY  Chimical - Fisic Charateristics   :  -   % Vanilline : 1,6   -   2,4%  -   Lenght : 16 - 22 cm  -   Umiditày   : MAX 35 %  Nutritional values X 100 gr.:  -   Energiy : 200Kcal (1181KJ)  -   Proteins : 4,5 g  -   Carboidraty : 52,9 g  -   Lipidi : 7.8g  Fisic   - Organolettics Charateristics :  -   Colorr : Brown   -   Black  -   Smell : cocoa - cioccolat  -   Flavor : sweet / sour  -   Appearance : bean  Analysis Laboratory: The products are analyzed by sample at LCM   -   Antananarivo   -   on request the products  they can be accompanied by analysis certificates made in Italy at PH Florence  Ogm : This product does not contain, is not made up and is not obtained from genetically engineered organisms  modified, in compliance with the provisions of EC regulation n. 1829 and 1830 of 2003  Allergens: Compliant with Reg. 2000/13 / CE, Legislative Decree 114 of 08/02/2006, Reg. 1169/2011 and subsequent  amendments relating to product labeling. Keep away from heat and light sources.
